name: m03-3.9-linux
title: Lab 3.9: break SupportBot with a planted note, fix it in four layers, prove each fix (tests + promptfoo), then a real local model with all fixes
before: curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.22.0/node-v22.22.0-linux-x64.tar.xz -o node.tar.xz && sudo tar -xJf node.tar.xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 && rm node.tar.xz && node --version
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o ollama-install.sh && sh ollama-install.sh && rm -f ollama-install.sh
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && break; sleep 2; done
cd ai-security-course-labs/labs/m03 && PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 npx --yes promptfoo@0.124.1 --version

steps.label: Real model
steps.type: python3 support_bot.py reset && python3 support_bot.py summarise data/emails/03_planted_note.txt --backend ollama --fixes all
